worldcombat.skill.payday.summary: Weigh a small handful of coins and hurl them at the target: the coin string strikes physically, and the coins that miss or spill land around the impact as real, pickable coins. The largesse form throws more but hits lighter and slower.
worldcombat.skill.payday.use.0: Trade hits with a cheap, quick shot
worldcombat.skill.payday.use.1: Leave pickable coins around the impact
worldcombat.skill.payday.use.2: Harass from range without spending your rhythm
worldcombat.skill.payday.description.0: The coin string deals %1$s physical damage to the target.
worldcombat.skill.payday.description.1: One throw sends about %1$s coins, range %2$s blocks, launch speed %3$s blocks/tick.
worldcombat.skill.payday.description.2: About %1$s real coins scatter around the impact at %2$s blocks/tick; anyone can pick them up.
worldcombat.skill.payday.largesse.on: Currently largesse: more coins thrown and spilled, but a lighter shot with a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.payday.largesse.off: Currently one heavy handful: fewer coins, a heavier shot and a faster hand.
worldcombat.skill.payday.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.payday.growth.0: From level %1$s the shot rises to %2$s power and %3$s coins per throw.
worldcombat.skill.payday.growth.1: From level %1$s the shot rises to %2$s power and %3$s coins hit the ground.
worldcombat.skill.payday.preference.larg: On: coins thrown ×1.5, coins spilled ×1.4, a wider show on the field, but shot power ×0.82, +2 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown. Off: one heavy handful, faster and harder, with fewer coins spilled.
worldcombat.skill.payday.preference.ai.m: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values let it open from further away.
